title: Cokernel and image of a morphism of quasi-coherent modules: quasi-coherent, computed on affine opens
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ a morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] between quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $q:\mathcal G\to\operatorname{Coker}\varphi$ be the cokernel of $\varphi$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$, i.e. the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $U\mapsto\mathcal G(U)/\varphi_U(\mathcal F(U))$, with $q$ the composite of the quotient maps and the sheafification map; and let $\operatorname{Im}\varphi\subseteq\mathcal G$ be the subsheaf of local sections of $\mathcal G$ that are locally in the image of $\varphi$: $(\operatorname{Im}\varphi)(W)=\{s\in\mathcal G(W):$ every point of $W$ has an open neighbourhood $V\subseteq W$ with $s|_V\in\varphi_V(\mathcal F(V))\}$. Then: (1) $\operatorname{Im}\varphi$ is a sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module of $\mathcal G$ and equals $\ker q$ (sectionwise kernel), $\varphi$ factors through $\operatorname{Im}\varphi$, and $q$ is an epimorphism with $q\circ\varphi=0$; (2) $\operatorname{Coker}\varphi$ and $\operatorname{Im}\varphi$ are quasi-coherent; (3) for every affine open $U\subseteq X$: $(\operatorname{Im}\varphi)(U)=\varphi_U(\mathcal F(U))$, and $q_U:\mathcal G(U)\to(\operatorname{Coker}\varphi)(U)$ is surjective with kernel $\varphi_U(\mathcal F(U))$, so that $(\operatorname{Coker}\varphi)(U)=\mathcal G(U)/\varphi_U(\mathcal F(U))$ as $\mathcal O_X(U)$-modules.
